people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

translations.web: The men pursued them along the way to the fords of the Jordan River. As soon as those who pursued them had gone out, they shut the gate.
translations.bsb: So the king’s men set out in pursuit of the spies along the road to the fords of the Jordan, and as soon as they had gone out, the gate was shut.
translations.kjv: And the men pursued after them the way to Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they which pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
translations.asv: And the men pursued after them the way to the Jordan unto the fords: and as soon as they that pursued after them were gone out, they shut the gate.
